definition_en: a white or grey mass of water drops in the sky, a mass of smoke or dust, or a state of doubt and trouble
core_image: 山谷上方停着的一团白云
scene: 清晨的山谷里，白色的雾团慢慢越过山脊。A single cloud hung above the valley all afternoon.
sceneCN: 这里 cloud 指「云」（第 1 个义项：天空中水汽凝成的一团）；句意是一整团云在山谷上方停了一下午。

senses.title: A mass of water drops
senses.definition: a white or grey mass of small water drops floating in the sky
senses.definitionCN: 漂浮在空中、由小水珠组成的白色或灰色团块
senses.example: Dark clouds gathered over the sea before the storm.
senses.exampleCN: 暴风雨前，乌云在海上聚拢。
senses.why: The old word for a hill was used for these white masses because they look like hills in the sky.
senses.whyCN: 古时指小山的词被用来称这些白色团块，因为它们在天空里像山。

senses.title: A mass of smoke or dust
senses.definition: a moving mass of smoke, dust or insects in the air
senses.definitionCN: 空气中移动的一团烟、尘或昆虫
senses.example: A cloud of dust rose from the road.
senses.exampleCN: 路上腾起一团尘土。
senses.why: Anything that hangs and drifts in the air has the same shape as a cloud.
senses.whyCN: 任何悬在空中漂移的东西，形状都和云一样。

senses.title: A shadow of doubt
senses.definition: a state of suspicion or unhappiness that hangs over someone
senses.definitionCN: 笼罩在某人身上的怀疑或不快状态
senses.example: The scandal left him under a cloud.
senses.exampleCN: 那桩丑闻让他蒙上了阴影。
senses.why: A cloud can hide the sun, so the word became a picture of trouble over a person.
senses.whyCN: 云能遮住太阳，于是这个词成了麻烦笼罩某人的写照。

intro.en: Cloud first meant a hill, and only later the white mass above it.
intro.cn: cloud 最初指小山，后来才指山上方那团白色的东西。

items.en: Clud meant a rock or a hill.
items.cn: clud 指岩石或小山。

items.en: Cloud took over as the everyday word for vapour in the sky.
items.cn: cloud 取代旧词，成为天空中水汽的日常说法。

items.en: The word widened to smoke, dust and moving masses of insects.
items.cn: 这个词扩展到烟、尘与移动的虫群。

items.en: Under a cloud became a fixed phrase for disgrace.
items.cn: under a cloud 成为表示失宠受疑的固定短语。

items.en: Cloud now also names remote storage that users never see.
items.cn: cloud 如今还指用户看不见的远程存储。

note.en: The look-alike group holds short words close in spelling, while the meaning group names air full of fine drops.
note.cn: 形近组收拼写接近的短词，近义组列出充满细微水汽的天气现象。

entries.definition: a lump of earth or clay
entries.definitionCN: 一块泥土或黏土

entries.definition: a performer who makes people laugh
entries.definitionCN: 逗人发笑的表演者

entries.definition: a large number of people in one place
entries.definitionCN: 聚集在一处的一大群人

entries.definition: thin cloud near the ground that limits sight
entries.definitionCN: 贴近地面、遮挡视线的薄云

entries.definition: thick cloud at ground level
entries.definitionCN: 地面附近浓厚的雾

entries.definition: light mist caused by heat or dust
entries.definitionCN: 由热气或尘埃造成的轻雾

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the hill inside the word, the drifting shape and the shadow over a name.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从词里的小山、漂移的形状和笼罩名声的阴影入手。

normal.en: Cloud once meant a hill, and a cloud is a hill made of water.
normal.cn: cloud 曾指小山，而云就是水做成的山。

normal.en: Cloudy adds y, and the y turns the noun into weather.
normal.cn: cloudy 加了 y，就把名词变成了天气。

normal.en: On cloud nine means so happy that you are above the ground.
normal.cn: on cloud nine 指快乐得像飘在云上。

normal.en: Under a cloud means the shadow has not lifted.
normal.cn: under a cloud 指阴影还没有散去。

normal.en: Cloud computing hides the machines the way a cloud hides the sun.
normal.cn: cloud computing 把机器藏起来，就像云遮住太阳。

abstract.en: Picture one white mass stuck above a green valley.
abstract.cn: 想象一团白云停在翠绿的山谷上方。

abstract.en: Picture dust rising in a long line behind a truck.
abstract.cn: 想象卡车后面扬起长长一条尘土。

abstract.en: Picture a grey patch over a person's name on a list.
abstract.cn: 想象名单上某个名字上方有一块灰影。

examples.en: A thin cloud passed across the moon.
examples.cn: 一片薄云掠过月亮。

examples.en: The sky clouded over just before noon.
examples.cn: 临近中午时天阴了下来。

examples.en: He left office under a cloud of suspicion.
examples.cn: 他在一片怀疑声中离职。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 cloud 记成「天上的小山」：白软的团块慢慢移动，遮住太阳就成阴影。

root: 源自古英语 clud（岩石、小山），因云形似山而转指天空中的水汽团。

sensesIntro.en: From a hill of vapour to any drifting mass, and then to the shadow of doubt.
sensesIntro.cn: 从水汽堆成的小山，到任何漂移的团块，再到怀疑的阴影。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a white mass that drifts and hides the sun.
core.cn: 核心意象：一团白色之物漂移并遮住太阳。

branches.en: The weather sense is the everyday core of the word.
branches.cn: 天气义是这个词的日常核心。

branches.en: Smoke and dust copy the shape and the drift of a cloud.
branches.cn: 烟与尘复制了云的形状与漂移。

branches.en: A cloud that hides the sun becomes a picture of hidden trouble.
branches.cn: 遮住太阳的云成了隐藏麻烦的写照。

branches.en: Both senses describe a soft mass hanging in the air.
branches.cn: 两个义项都描述悬在空中的柔软团块。

branches.en: The same image covers weather and reputation.
branches.cn: 同一个意象既覆盖天气，也覆盖名声。

intro.en: The stem takes the usual adjective endings and a set of modern compounds.
intro.cn: 这个词干接受常见形容词词尾，并构成一批现代复合词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin base; the root is the Old English noun clud, a hill.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁词基，词根是古英语名词 clud（小山）。

items.meaning: more than one mass of vapour
items.example: Thin clouds crossed the sky all day.
items.exampleCN: 一整天都有薄云掠过天空。

items.meaning: covered with cloud or made unclear
items.meaningCN: 被云遮住的；变得模糊的
items.example: His judgement was clouded by anger.
items.exampleCN: 他的判断被愤怒弄模糊了。

items.meaning: the act of becoming cloudy
items.example: Clouding of the glass spoiled the view.
items.exampleCN: 玻璃起雾破坏了视野。

items.meaning: full of clouds or not clear
items.example: It will be cloudy but dry tomorrow.
items.exampleCN: 明天多云但干燥。

items.meaning: having no clouds at all
items.example: The night was cloudless and cold.
items.exampleCN: 那个夜晚无云而寒冷。

items.meaning: the state of being cloudy
items.example: Cloudiness increased towards evening.
items.exampleCN: 临近傍晚云量增多。

items.meaning: a sudden very heavy fall of rain
items.example: A cloudburst flooded the street.
items.exampleCN: 一场暴雨淹了街道。

items.meaning: the amount of sky hidden by cloud
items.example: Cloud cover reached eighty percent.
items.exampleCN: 云量达到八成。

definition_zh: 俱乐部；社团；棍棒；（高尔夫）球杆；夜总会
definition_en: a group of people who share an interest, the place where they meet, a heavy stick, or a place for dancing at night
core_image: 街角老屋门上那块写着会员名字的木牌
scene: 街角那家老房子的门上挂着一块木牌，写着会员的名字。He joined the chess club at school.
sceneCN: 这里 club 指「俱乐部；社团」（第 1 个义项：因共同兴趣组成的团体）；句意是他加入了学校的棋类社团。

pos.zh: 俱乐部；社团；棍棒；夜总会

collocations.zh: 高尔夫球杆；高尔夫俱乐部

senses.title: A group with a shared interest
senses.definition: an organised group of people who meet because of a common interest
senses.definitionCN: 因共同兴趣而聚会的有组织团体
senses.example: She joined the swimming club last spring.
senses.exampleCN: 她去年春天加入了游泳俱乐部。
senses.why: A group of people who banded together was seen as a single thick mass, so the word for a stick moved to people.
senses.whyCN: 聚在一起的一群人被看成一整块厚实的东西，于是棍棒之词转向了人群。

senses.title: A heavy stick
senses.definition: a thick heavy stick used as a weapon or in a game
senses.definitionCN: 用作武器或运动器具的粗重木棒
senses.example: He swung the club and the ball flew over the green.
senses.exampleCN: 他挥动球杆，球飞过了果岭。
senses.why: This is the oldest sense, a lump of wood used to hit things.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的义项，一块用来击打的木头。

senses.title: A place for dancing at night
senses.definition: a place where people go late at night to dance and listen to music
senses.definitionCN: 人们深夜去跳舞听音乐的场所
senses.example: The club was full until three in the morning.
senses.exampleCN: 这家夜总会一直热闹到凌晨三点。
senses.why: A night club began as a members' club with music, and the place kept the shorter name.
senses.whyCN: 夜总会最初是带音乐表演的会员俱乐部，场所沿用了这个短名。

intro.en: Club began as a lump of wood in Old Norse and only later named a group of people.
intro.cn: club 最初是古诺尔斯语中一块木头，后来才指一群人。

items.en: Klubba meant a heavy lump or a wooden stick.
items.cn: klubba 指沉重的块状物或木棒。

items.en: Club entered English as a thick stick used to strike.
items.cn: club 以击打用的粗木棒之义进入英语。

items.en: A group of people with one interest took the name club.
items.cn: 有着共同兴趣的一群人开始被称为 club。

items.en: The golf club and the night club widened the word.
items.cn: 高尔夫球杆与夜总会进一步扩展了这个词。

items.en: A club is now a group, a building, a stick or a bat.
items.cn: club 如今可指团体、场所、木棒或球棒。

note.en: The look-alike group holds short words close in shape, while the meaning group names groups and hitting tools.
note.cn: 形近组收形状接近的短词，近义组列出团体与击打器具。

entries.definition: a small group of plants growing close together
entries.definitionCN: 紧挨着生长的一小丛植物

entries.definition: a young fox, bear or lion
entries.definitionCN: 狐狸、熊或狮子的幼崽

entries.definition: a fact that helps to solve a problem
entries.definitionCN: 有助于解决问题的线索

entries.definition: an organised group with a shared aim
entries.definitionCN: 有共同目标的有组织团体

entries.definition: a group of people joined for a purpose
entries.definitionCN: 为某个目的联合起来的一群人

entries.definition: a shaped stick used to hit a ball
entries.definitionCN: 用来击球的成形木棒

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the wooden stick, the circle of members and the name over the door.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从木棒、围成一圈的会员和门上的招牌入手。

normal.en: A club was once a stick, and a group is a stick of people standing together.
normal.cn: club 曾经是木棒，而一群人就是一根由人凑成的棒。

normal.en: The golf club is the stick, the golf club is also the group: context decides.
normal.cn: golf club 既是球杆也是俱乐部，要看上下文。

normal.en: Club and clump both start with cl, a sound of things massed together.
normal.cn: club 与 clump 都以 cl 开头，带有一堆东西聚拢的感觉。

normal.en: A night club keeps only half the old phrase, as places often do.
normal.cn: night club 只保留了旧短语的后半，场所常这样简称。

normal.en: Clubber is the person, clubbable is the friendly type.
normal.cn: clubber 指人，clubbable 指好交际的类型。

abstract.en: Picture a heavy wooden stick leaning against a wall.
abstract.cn: 想象一根粗木棒靠在墙边。

abstract.en: Picture a circle of chairs in a small room, everyone facing in.
abstract.cn: 想象小屋里一圈椅子，人人朝内而坐。

abstract.en: Picture a brass plate beside a door with a short list of names.
abstract.cn: 想象门边一块铜牌，上面写着短短几个名字。

examples.en: The reading club meets on Thursday evenings.
examples.cn: 读书会每周四晚上聚会。

examples.en: He keeps an old wooden club behind the door.
examples.cn: 他在门后放着一根旧木棒。

examples.en: They danced at a club near the station.
examples.cn: 他们在车站附近的一家夜总会跳舞。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 club 记成「一根木棒」：古人拿棒聚在一起，棒围成圈，就成了社团。

root: 源自古诺尔斯语 klubba（粗木块、木棒），中古英语指击打用的棍棒，十七世纪起指兴趣团体。

sensesIntro.en: From a lump of wood to a group of people, then to the place where they meet at night.
sensesIntro.cn: 从一块木头，到一群人，再到他们夜里相聚的场所。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a thick wooden stick, and a circle of people around it.
core.cn: 核心意象：一根粗木棒，以及围着它的一圈人。

branches.en: People bound by one interest form a single body with a name.
branches.cn: 因同一兴趣而结合的人形成一个有名号的整体。

branches.en: The stick sense is the oldest and the most physical.
branches.cn: 棍棒义最古老，也最具体。

branches.en: A club with music and late hours became the night club.
branches.cn: 有音乐、开到深夜的俱乐部成了夜总会。

branches.en: Both senses name a place that members enter.
branches.cn: 两个义项都指会员可以进入的场所。

branches.en: A group and a stick both suggest something solid and united.
branches.cn: 团体与木棒都暗示某种结实而联结的东西。

intro.en: The stem makes agent nouns, adjectives and many compounds for places and groups.
intro.cn: 这个词干构成施动名词、形容词以及大量表示场所与团体的复合词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin base; the root is Old Norse klubba, a lump of wood.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁词基，词根是古诺尔斯语 klubba（木块）。

items.meaning: more than one group or stick
items.example: Three clubs share the same hall.
items.exampleCN: 三个俱乐部共用同一个大厅。

items.meaning: a person who often goes to night clubs
items.example: The street is full of clubbers at midnight.
items.exampleCN: 午夜时街上满是夜店客。

items.meaning: good at making friends in groups
items.example: He is a clubbable and easy man.
items.exampleCN: 他是个好交际、随和的人。

items.meaning: friendly only to insiders
items.example: The staff seemed a little clubby.
items.exampleCN: 员工之间显得有些小圈子。

items.meaning: the building used by a club
items.example: The team met in the clubhouse.
items.exampleCN: 队员在会所集合。

items.meaning: a person who belongs to a club
items.example: Every club member pays a small fee.
items.exampleCN: 每位会员交一点费用。

items.meaning: a stick for hitting a golf ball
items.example: He chose a lighter golf club.
items.exampleCN: 他选了一根较轻的球杆。

items.meaning: a place open late for music and dancing
items.example: The nightclub closes at four.
items.exampleCN: 这家夜总会四点关门。

definition_en: a fact or object that helps to solve a problem or a mystery, or an understanding of a situation
core_image: 桌上摊开的纸片被一根线串起来
scene: 侦探把桌上的纸片一张张排开，寻找能串起来的线索。A single footprint gave the police their first clue.
sceneCN: 这里 clue 指「线索」（第 1 个义项：有助于解开谜团的事实或物件）；句意是一个脚印给了警方第一条线索。

senses.title: A fact that helps solve a mystery
senses.definition: a piece of evidence that points towards the answer
senses.definitionCN: 指向答案的一件证据
senses.example: The note was the only clue to his whereabouts.
senses.exampleCN: 那张字条是唯一能说明他去向的线索。
senses.why: A clue was a ball of thread that guided a hero out of a maze, so it still means something that guides.
senses.whyCN: clue 原是一团把英雄引出迷宫的线，因此至今指能引路的东西。

senses.title: Knowledge of a situation
senses.definition: an idea or understanding of what is happening
senses.definitionCN: 对正在发生之事的一点概念或了解
senses.example: She had no clue how the machine worked.
senses.exampleCN: 她对这台机器怎么运作毫无头绪。
senses.why: If a thread shows the way, then having a clue means knowing which way to go.
senses.whyCN: 如果线能指路，那么有线索就意味着知道往哪走。

intro.en: Clue comes from an old word for a ball of thread, the kind a hero used to find his way out.
intro.cn: clue 出自表示线团的古词，正是英雄用来找路走出迷宫的那种线。

items.en: Cliwen meant a ball of thread or yarn.
items.cn: cliwen 指一团线或纱。

items.en: A clew of thread guided a person through a maze in an old story.
items.cn: 在古老故事里，一团线引导人走出迷宫。

items.en: The spelling clue appeared beside the older clew.
items.cn: 拼写 clue 与较早的 clew 并行出现。

items.en: The meaning widened from thread to any guiding fact.
items.cn: 含义从线扩展到任何起引导作用的事实。

items.en: A clue is now a fact that helps solve a problem.
items.cn: clue 如今指有助于解决问题的线索。

note.en: The look-alike group holds short words with the same sound or shape, while the meaning group names signs and evidence.
note.cn: 形近组收同音或形近的短词，近义组列出迹象与证据。

entries.definition: a thick liquid used to stick things together
entries.definitionCN: 用来粘合东西的黏稠液体

entries.definition: having the colour of a clear sky
entries.definitionCN: 具有晴空那种颜色的

entries.definition: a signal that tells someone to begin
entries.definitionCN: 提示某人开始的信号

entries.definition: a small piece of advice that helps you guess
entries.definitionCN: 帮助猜测的一点点提示

entries.definition: something that shows that a fact exists
entries.definitionCN: 显示某种事实存在的事物

entries.definition: facts that support a belief or a case
entries.definitionCN: 支持某种看法或案件的事实

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the ball of thread, the maze and the moment of having no idea.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从线团、迷宫和毫无头绪的那一刻入手。

normal.en: Clue and clew are the same word; clew is the old spelling for a ball of thread.
normal.cn: clue 与 clew 本是同一个词，clew 是线团的旧拼法。

normal.en: Clue and glue differ by one letter: glue sticks, a clue leads.
normal.cn: clue 与 glue 只差一个字母：胶水粘住，线索引路。

normal.en: A detective follows a clue the way a hero follows a thread.
normal.cn: 侦探顺线索查案，就像英雄顺线而行。

normal.en: No clue means the thread has slipped out of your hand.
normal.cn: no clue 就是线从手里滑走了。

normal.en: Clueless adds -less, so the person has no guiding thread at all.
normal.cn: clueless 加了 -less，指人一点引路的线都没有。

abstract.en: Picture a red thread running along a stone floor in the dark.
abstract.cn: 想象黑暗中一条红线沿着石地延伸。

abstract.en: Picture a footprint in soft mud beside a broken gate.
abstract.cn: 想象破门旁软泥里的一枚脚印。

abstract.en: Picture a person shrugging in front of a confusing map.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人面对看不懂的地图耸了耸肩。

examples.en: The muddy shoe left a clue beside the door.
examples.cn: 那只沾泥的鞋在门边留下了线索。

examples.en: Nobody had a clue what the letter meant.
examples.cn: 没人知道那封信是什么意思。

examples.en: Her calm reply gave him a clue about her mood.
examples.cn: 她平静的回答让他对她的情绪有了点头绪。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 clue 记成「一团线」：握住线头，顺着走，就能走出迷雾。

root: 源自古英语 cliwen（线团），旧拼 clew，因线团引路的故事引申为线索。

sensesIntro.en: From a thread that leads the way to any fact that leads the mind.
sensesIntro.cn: 从引路的线，到任何能引出思路的事实。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a thread held in the hand, running into the dark.
core.cn: 核心意象：手里握着一根线，伸进黑暗里。

branches.en: The evidence sense keeps the picture of a guiding thread.
branches.cn: 证据义保留了引路线索的画面。

branches.en: Having a clue means holding the thread of a situation.
branches.cn: 有头绪就意味着握着局势的线头。

branches.en: Both senses describe something that reduces confusion.
branches.cn: 两个义项都描述能减少困惑的东西。

branches.en: A clue points outward, to a fact in the world.
branches.cn: 线索向外指，指向世间的一件事实。

branches.en: The same thread can lead to a suspect or to understanding.
branches.cn: 同一根线既能引向嫌疑人，也能引向理解。

intro.en: The stem keeps the old thread word alive and adds modern compounds.
intro.cn: 这个词干保住了古老的线团词，并构成现代复合词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin base; the root is the Old English noun cliwen.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁词基，词根是古英语名词 cliwen。

items.meaning: more than one piece of evidence
items.example: The room offered several clues.
items.exampleCN: 这个房间提供了好几条线索。

items.meaning: knowing nothing about a matter
items.example: He was clueless about the new rules.
items.exampleCN: 他对新规则一无所知。

items.meaning: complete lack of knowledge
items.example: Her cluelessness surprised the team.
items.exampleCN: 她的一无所知让团队吃惊。

items.meaning: well informed about something
items.example: He is clued-up on local politics.
items.exampleCN: 他对本地政治很了解。

items.meaning: a ball of thread, the older form of clue
items.example: Clew still appears in sailing texts.
items.exampleCN: clew 仍出现在航海文本中。

items.meaning: the activity of searching for clues
items.example: Clue-hunting took the whole afternoon.
items.exampleCN: 找线索花了整个下午。

items.meaning: built on hints rather than direct proof
items.example: The game is a clue-based puzzle.
items.exampleCN: 这个游戏是基于线索的解谜。

items.meaning: that supplies helpful hints
items.example: She made a few clue-giving remarks.
items.exampleCN: 她说了几句提示性的话。

definition_zh: 教练；长途汽车；（火车）车厢；辅导
definition_en: a person who trains a team or a performer, a bus for long journeys, or to train someone
core_image: 球场边蹲下来对球员说话的那个人
scene: 球场边，一位穿运动服的人蹲下来，对球员比划传球的方向。The coach stopped the drill to explain the pass again.
sceneCN: 这里 coach 指「教练」（第 1 个义项：训练队伍的人）；句意是教练停下训练，重新讲解传球。

senses.title: A person who trains others
senses.definition: a person who trains a sports team or an individual performer
senses.definitionCN: 训练运动队或个别运动员的人
senses.example: The coach praised the team after the match.
senses.exampleCN: 赛后教练表扬了队伍。
senses.why: A coach once carried people to a place, and a trainer now carries a learner to a goal.
senses.whyCN: coach 曾是把人送到某处的马车，而教练是把学习者带向目标的人。

senses.title: A long-distance bus or carriage
senses.definition: a bus used for journeys between towns, or a carriage of a train
senses.definitionCN: 往返城镇之间的客车，或火车的一节车厢
senses.example: We travelled by coach from London to the coast.
senses.exampleCN: 我们乘长途汽车从伦敦去海边。
senses.why: The word entered English as a carriage, and the vehicle sense has never been lost.
senses.whyCN: 这个词以马车之义进入英语，车辆义从未消失。

senses.title: Train or tutor someone
senses.definition: to teach someone the skills of a sport or a subject
senses.definitionCN: 教某人某项运动或某门学科的技能
senses.example: She coaches students in maths on weekends.
senses.exampleCN: 她周末给学生辅导数学。
senses.why: The verb grew from the person who carries learners forward, first at university and then on the field.
senses.whyCN: 动词由「带着学习者前进的人」而来，先在大学出现，后进入球场。

intro.en: Coach comes from a Hungarian village that built good wagons, not from anything about sport.
intro.cn: coach 出自一个会造好车的匈牙利村庄，与体育毫无关系。

items.en: Kocsi named a wagon built in the village of Kocs.
items.cn: kocsi 指在科奇村制造的马车。

items.en: The word became coche, a comfortable carriage.
items.cn: 这个词在法语中成为 coche，指舒适的马车。

items.en: Coach named a horse-drawn carriage for passengers.
items.cn: coach 指载客的马拉车。

items.en: Students used coach for a private tutor who carried them through exams.
items.cn: 学生用 coach 指带他们通过考试的私人辅导老师。

items.en: Coach now covers buses, train carriages and sports trainers.
items.cn: coach 如今涵盖长途汽车、火车车厢与体育教练。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words close in spelling, while the meaning group names trainers and passenger vehicles.
note.cn: 形近组收拼写接近的词，近义组列出教练与载客车辆。

entries.definition: a long soft seat for two or more people
entries.definitionCN: 可供两三人坐的长软椅

entries.definition: a piece of clothing worn over other clothes
entries.definitionCN: 穿在其他衣服外面的衣物

entries.definition: as many people as a bus can carry
entries.definitionCN: 一客车的人

entries.definition: a person who teaches a sport or a skill
entries.definitionCN: 教授运动或技能的人

entries.definition: a teacher who works with one student or a small group
entries.definitionCN: 对一名或少数学生授课的教师

entries.definition: a large road vehicle that carries passengers
entries.definitionCN: 在公路上载客的大型车辆

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the Hungarian village, the carriage and the person who carries a learner forward.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从匈牙利村庄、马车和带着学习者前进的人入手。

normal.en: Coach and couch differ by one letter: a coach carries you, a couch holds you.
normal.cn: coach 与 couch 只差一个字母：前者载你走，后者托你坐。

normal.en: The first coach was a wagon from a village called Kocs.
normal.cn: 最早的 coach 是来自科奇村的马车。

normal.en: A coach takes you from town to town, and a coach takes you from novice to expert.
normal.cn: coach 送你从一镇到另一镇，也送你从新手到熟手。

normal.en: Head coach is the top one, assistant coach is the helper.
normal.cn: head coach 是主教练，assistant coach 是助理。

normal.en: The verb coach keeps the same spelling, so only the ending changes.
normal.cn: 动词 coach 拼写不变，只有词尾变化。

abstract.en: Picture a wooden carriage with four horses on a dusty road.
abstract.cn: 想象一辆四匹马拉的木马车走在土路上。

abstract.en: Picture a whistle, a cone and a coach kneeling on the grass.
abstract.cn: 想象哨子、标志锥，以及跪在草地上的教练。

abstract.en: Picture a student and a tutor at a small table with one lamp.
abstract.cn: 想象学生与辅导老师在一张小桌旁，只有一盏灯。

examples.en: The coach changed the formation at half time.
examples.cn: 教练在中场休息时改变了阵型。

examples.en: A coach leaves for the airport every hour.
examples.cn: 每小时有一班长途汽车开往机场。

examples.en: He coached the younger players for two seasons.
examples.cn: 他带了年轻队员两个赛季。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 coach 记成「把你送到目的地的人或车」：车载人上路，教练带人上路。

root: 源自匈牙利语 kocsi（科奇村造的车），经法语 coche 进入英语，由马车引申为客车与教练。

sensesIntro.en: From a village wagon to a passenger bus, and then to the person who carries a learner forward.
sensesIntro.cn: 从村庄的马车，到载客的汽车，再到带着学习者前进的人。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a vehicle that carries people towards a place.
core.cn: 核心意象：一辆把人送往某地的车。

branches.en: The trainer sense keeps the idea of carrying a learner to a goal.
branches.cn: 教练义保留了把学习者带向目标的意味。

branches.en: The vehicle sense is the oldest and still the most literal.
branches.cn: 车辆义最古老，也最字面。

branches.en: The verb turns the carrier into an action of teaching.
branches.cn: 动词把「运送者」变成教学的动作。

branches.en: The person and the act of training share one word.
branches.cn: 教练这个人与训练这个动作共用一个词。

branches.en: Both senses describe help with getting somewhere.
branches.cn: 两个义项都描述帮助人抵达某处。

intro.en: The stem takes the usual verb endings and compounds for vehicles and people.
intro.cn: 这个词干接受常见动词词尾，并构成车辆与人物类复合词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin base; the root is Hungarian kocsi, a wagon from the village of Kocs.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁词基，词根是匈牙利语 kocsi（科奇村的马车）。

items.meaning: trains a person or a team
items.example: She coaches the junior team.
items.exampleCN: 她带少年队。

items.meaning: trained someone in a skill
items.example: He coached her through the exam.
items.exampleCN: 他辅导她通过了考试。

items.meaning: the work of training people
items.example: Coaching takes patience more than knowledge.
items.exampleCN: 辅导需要耐心多于知识。

items.meaning: as many people as a bus holds
items.example: A coachload of tourists arrived at noon.
items.exampleCN: 一车游客中午到了。

items.meaning: a person who drove a horse-drawn coach
items.example: The coachman waited in the rain.
items.exampleCN: 马车夫在雨里等着。

items.meaning: a place where long-distance buses stop
items.example: The coach station is behind the market.
items.exampleCN: 长途汽车站在市场后面。

items.meaning: a journey made by long-distance bus
items.example: The school arranged a coach trip.
items.exampleCN: 学校安排了一次大巴旅行。

items.meaning: the leading trainer of a team
items.example: The head coach signed a new contract.
items.exampleCN: 主教练签了新合同。

definition_en: a hard black substance dug from the ground and burned as fuel, or a piece of it
core_image: 矿井口传送带上不断滑下的黑色煤块
scene: 矿井口的传送带上，黑色的煤块不断滑下来。A truck loaded with coal left the mine before dawn.
sceneCN: 这里 coal 指「煤」（第 1 个义项：从地下挖出的黑色燃料）；句意是一辆装满煤的卡车在天亮前离开了矿场。

senses.title: Black fuel from the ground
senses.definition: a hard black rock formed from ancient plants and burned for heat
senses.definitionCN: 由远古植物形成、烧来取暖的黑色坚硬岩石
senses.example: The old stove still burns coal in winter.
senses.exampleCN: 入冬后那只旧炉子仍烧煤。
senses.why: The word first meant a glowing piece of charcoal, and the black rock took the same name.
senses.whyCN: 这个词原指一块烧红的木炭，黑色岩石便沿用了同一个名字。

senses.title: A single burning piece
senses.definition: one piece of coal, especially one that is burning
senses.definitionCN: 一块煤，尤指正在燃烧的一块
senses.example: He put another lump of coal on the fire.
senses.exampleCN: 他又往火里添了一块煤。
senses.why: A mass noun naturally gains a countable piece when people handle it by the lump.
senses.whyCN: 人们按块取用煤，不可数名词便自然有了可数的单块之义。

intro.en: Coal is an old Germanic word that first meant charcoal, not the rock in the mine.
intro.cn: coal 是古老的日耳曼语词，最初指木炭，而不是矿井里的岩石。

items.en: Col meant charcoal or a glowing piece of wood.
items.cn: col 指木炭或一块烧红的木头。

items.en: Related words in German and Dutch named burning fuel.
items.cn: 德语和荷兰语中的相关词指燃烧的燃料。

items.en: Coal widened from charcoal to the black rock dug from the earth.
items.cn: coal 从木炭扩展为从地下挖出的黑色岩石。

items.en: Coal powered engines, trains and factories.
items.cn: 煤推动了发动机、火车与工厂。

items.en: Coal now appears mostly in talk about energy and climate.
items.cn: coal 如今多出现在能源与气候的讨论里。

note.en: The look-alike group holds short words close in spelling, while the meaning group names fuels and burned wood.
note.cn: 形近组收拼写接近的短词，近义组列出燃料与烧过的木头。

entries.definition: a length of rope or wire wound in rings
entries.definitionCN: 盘成环形的一段绳或线

entries.definition: an outer garment, or a layer covering a surface
entries.definitionCN: 外套，或覆盖表面的层

entries.definition: a point scored, or the aim you want to reach
entries.definitionCN: 得分，或想要达到的目标

entries.definition: black material made by burning wood slowly
entries.definitionCN: 木材慢烧制成的黑色材料

entries.definition: material burned to produce heat or power
entries.definitionCN: 燃烧以产生热或动力的材料

entries.definition: coal treated to burn very hot
entries.definitionCN: 经处理可烧得极热的煤

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the old charcoal sense, the black rock and the glow in a stove.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从古老木炭义、黑色岩石和炉中的红光入手。

normal.en: Coal and goal rhyme, but coal burns while a goal waits.
normal.cn: coal 与 goal 押韵，但煤会烧，球门在等。

normal.en: Coal keeps the old sense of a glowing piece in the phrase coals of fire.
normal.cn: coals of fire 这个说法保留了「烧红的炭块」的旧义。

normal.en: Charcoal is wood that has been turned into coal.
normal.cn: charcoal 就是木头变成的炭。

normal.en: Coal formed from plants under pressure for millions of years.
normal.cn: 煤是植物在压力下历经数百万年形成的。

normal.en: Coal-fired adds a participle and turns the noun into an adjective.
normal.cn: coal-fired 加分词，把名词变作形容词。

abstract.en: Picture a dark pit head with a belt of black lumps.
abstract.cn: 想象幽暗的井口，传送带上全是黑色的块。

abstract.en: Picture a single red eye glowing in a grey stove.
abstract.cn: 想象灰炉里透出一点红光。

abstract.en: Picture a white hill of snow with three black lumps in a bucket.
abstract.cn: 想象雪白的地上一只桶，桶里三块黑煤。

examples.en: The village grew beside a coal mine.
examples.cn: 这个村子在一座煤矿旁发展起来。

examples.en: She added a lump of coal to keep the room warm.
examples.cn: 她添了一块煤让屋子保持暖和。

examples.en: Coal smoke hung over the older parts of the city.
examples.cn: 煤烟笼罩着城市的旧城区。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 coal 记成「黑里透红」：从土里挖出的黑石，丢进炉里便亮起红光。

root: 源自古英语 col（木炭、烧红的炭块），属日耳曼语族，后扩展指地下开采的煤炭。

sensesIntro.en: From a glowing piece of charcoal to the black rock, and back to one burning lump.
sensesIntro.cn: 从一块烧红的木炭，到黑色的岩石，再回到炉中单块的煤。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a black lump holding heat inside.
core.cn: 核心意象：一块内部藏着热量的黑石。

branches.en: The fuel sense is the modern mass noun dug from mines.
branches.cn: 燃料义是如今从矿井挖出的不可数名词。

branches.en: The countable piece comes from handling coal by the lump.
branches.cn: 可数义来自按块取用煤的方式。

branches.en: Both senses name the same black substance.
branches.cn: 两个义项指同一种黑色物质。

branches.en: Industry and railways once ran on this rock.
branches.cn: 工业与铁路曾靠这种岩石运转。

branches.en: A single lump is the smallest usable unit in a stove.
branches.cn: 一块煤是炉中最小的可用单位。

intro.en: The old noun builds compounds for mines, fires and the adjective of material.
intro.cn: 这个古老名词构成矿井、炉火类复合词与材料形容词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin base; the root is the Old English noun col.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁词基，词根是古英语名词 col。

items.meaning: pieces of coal
items.example: The fire was kept alive with red coals.
items.exampleCN: 通红的煤块让火一直没灭。

items.meaning: a large area where coal is found
items.example: The coalfield once employed thousands.
items.exampleCN: 这片煤田曾雇有数千人。

items.meaning: burning coal for power
items.example: The coal-fired plant closed last year.
items.exampleCN: 那座燃煤电厂去年关闭了。

items.meaning: containing coal or like coal
items.example: The rock has a coaly shine.
items.exampleCN: 这块岩石有煤一样的光泽。

items.meaning: a place where coal is dug out
items.example: He worked in a coal mine at sixteen.
items.exampleCN: 他十六岁就在煤矿干活。

items.meaning: fine particles of coal
items.example: Coal dust covered every surface.
items.exampleCN: 煤尘盖满了每一处表面。

items.meaning: a person who delivers coal

items.exampleCN: 送煤工每周来一次。

items.meaning: as dark as coal
