definition_en: a person who works with you, especially in the same office or organization
core_image: 同一间办公室里抬头就能看见的那张熟悉面孔
scene: 早会开始前，几个人在茶水间低声交谈。She asked a colleague to check the numbers.
sceneCN: 这里 colleague 指「同事」（第 1 个义项：同一单位共事的人）；句意是她请一位同事核对数字。

derivatives.zh: 同僚之间互相支持的氛围

senses.title: Someone you work with
senses.definition: a person who works with you in the same office or organization
senses.definitionCN: 在同一办公室或机构与你共事的人
senses.example: My colleague took the call while I was out.
senses.exampleCN: 我不在时我的同事接了电话。
senses.why: The Latin base meant one chosen together, a partner in a shared duty.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁词基意为被一起选中的人，即共同承担职责的伙伴。

senses.title: A fellow member of a profession
senses.definition: a person who belongs to the same profession as you
senses.definitionCN: 与您属于同一职业的人
senses.example: She is a colleague from another university.
senses.exampleCN: 她是一位来自另一所大学的同行。
senses.why: Scholars and doctors use it for equals beyond their own office.
senses.whyCN: 学者与医生用它指本单位之外的同行。

intro.en: Colleague comes from Latin collega, from com- together and legare, to choose or send.
intro.cn: colleague 出自拉丁语 collega，由 com-（一起）与 legare（选择、派遣）组成。

items.en: Legare meant to choose, send or appoint.
items.cn: legare 意为选择、派遣或任命。

items.en: Collega named a partner chosen to share an office.
items.cn: collega 指被选中共同任事的人。

items.en: French collègue carried the word toward English.
items.cn: 法语 collègue 把词带向英语。

items.en: English colleague first meant a fellow official.
items.cn: 英语 colleague 最初指同僚官员。

items.en: The word spread to offices, schools and hospitals.
items.cn: 这个词扩展到办公室、学校与医院。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words sharing the colleg- shape, while the meaning group names people who work or stand beside you.
note.cn: 形近组收的是共享 colleg- 形态的词，近义组列出与你共事或同级的人。

entries.definition: a place where students study after school
entries.definitionCN: 学生毕业后继续求学的机构

entries.definition: friendly and equal among people at work
entries.definitionCN: 同事之间友善平等的

entries.definition: a group of teams or countries joined together
entries.definitionCN: 联合在一起的球队或国家

entries.definition: a person who works in the same place as you
entries.definitionCN: 与你同在一处工作的人

entries.definition: a person connected with your work
entries.definitionCN: 与你的工作有关联的人

entries.definition: a person of the same age, rank or ability
entries.definitionCN: 年龄、级别或能力相当的人

normalIntro.en: These hooks read the word as chosen together, then move from the same office to the same profession.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子把它读成被一起选中，再从同一间办公室走到同一职业。

normal.en: Colleague and college share a beginning but not a meaning.
normal.cn: colleague 与 college 开头相同，意思却不同。

normal.en: Two colleagues are two people picked together for one job.
normal.cn: 两位同事就是为同一份工作被一起选中的两个人。

normal.en: The ending sounds like league, a group joined by a common aim.
normal.cn: 词尾听起来像 league，即因共同目标联合的群体。

normal.en: A colleague works beside you, a friend may not.
normal.cn: 同事在你身边工作，朋友却未必。

normal.en: The adjective collegial describes the friendly side of that relationship.
normal.cn: 形容词 collegial 描述这种关系中友善的一面。

abstract.en: Picture two desks facing each other under one lamp.
abstract.cn: 想象两张桌子在一盏灯下相对而放。

abstract.en: Picture a name tag on a door beside your own.
abstract.cn: 想象你门牌旁边的那块名牌。

abstract.en: Picture a hand passing a cup of tea across the aisle.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手把一杯茶递过走道。

examples.en: I share an office with two colleagues.
examples.cn: 我和两位同事共用一间办公室。

examples.en: A colleague from the lab helped me finish the report.
examples.cn: 实验室的一位同事帮我完成了报告。

examples.en: She greeted her former colleagues at the conference.
examples.cn: 她在会议上问候了以前的同事。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 colleague 记成 college 加 ague：同一所学院里一起做事的人，就是同事。

root: 源自拉丁语 collega，com-（一起）加 legare（选择、派遣），本指一起被任命共事的人。

sensesIntro.en: From the person at the next desk to the person in the same profession elsewhere.
sensesIntro.cn: 从隔壁桌的人，到身在别处却与你同行的人。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a familiar face rising from the next desk.
core.cn: 核心意象：从隔壁桌抬起头来的那张熟悉面孔。

branches.en: The office sense is the everyday one today.
branches.cn: 办公室义是今天最日常的用法。

branches.en: The professional sense reaches beyond one workplace.
branches.cn: 职业义超出了单个工作场所。

branches.en: Both senses rest on shared work rather than friendship.
branches.cn: 两个义项都建立在共同工作上，而非友谊。

branches.en: A colleague is chosen into the same duty, not born into it.
branches.cn: 同事是被选来共担职责的，而不是天生的关系。

branches.en: Researchers call their equals colleagues across the world.
branches.cn: 研究者把世界各地的同行都称为 colleague。

intro.en: The family grows from the Latin root legare, with collegial and collegiate forming the adjective side.
intro.cn: 这个词族从拉丁词根 legare 生长，collegial 与 collegiate 构成形容词一侧。

latinIntro.en: Collega and legare are the Latin sources, and college keeps the same root in a different sense.
latinIntro.cn: collega 与 legare 是拉丁语来源，college 以另一义保留同一词根。

items.meaning: more than one person you work with
items.example: Her colleagues supported the new plan.
items.exampleCN: 她的同事们支持这项新计划。

items.meaning: the relationship between colleagues
items.example: Good colleagueship made the work lighter.
items.exampleCN: 良好的同事情谊让工作轻松了些。

items.meaning: friendly and equal among colleagues
items.example: The department kept a collegial tone.
items.exampleCN: 这个部门保持着同僚式的友好气氛。

items.meaning: the quality of mutual support among colleagues
items.meaningCN: 同僚间互相支持的特性
items.example: Meetings are run with real collegiality.
items.exampleCN: 会议在真正的同僚氛围中进行。

items.meaning: a body of people, now a place of study
items.meaningCN: 原指一群共事者，现指学院
items.example: He teaches at a small college.
items.exampleCN: 他在一所小学院教书。

items.meaning: relating to a college or its members
items.meaningCN: 与学院或其成员有关的
items.example: The team plays in a collegiate league.
items.exampleCN: 这支队伍参加大学联赛。

items.meaning: a group joined for a common purpose
items.meaningCN: 为共同目的联合的群体
items.example: The two towns formed a league.
items.exampleCN: 两个镇结成了一个联盟。

items.meaning: to give a duty to another person
items.example: A good manager knows how to delegate.
items.exampleCN: 好的管理者懂得如何分派任务。

latinEntries.meaning: a partner in office or duty
latinEntries.example: The Roman collega shared power for one year.
latinEntries.exampleCN: 罗马的同僚共同掌权一年。

latinEntries.example: Legare also gives English the word delegate.
latinEntries.exampleCN: legare 也为英语提供了 delegate 一词。

definition_en: to bring things of the same kind together, to go and get something, or to gather in a group
core_image: 把散落在各处的同类物件拢进一只盒子
scene: 孩子把地上的贝壳一枚枚捡进小桶。He collects stamps from every country he visits.
sceneCN: 这里 collect 指「收集」（第 1 个义项：把同类东西收起来）；句意是他收集他去过的每个国家的邮票。

senses.title: Bring things together
senses.definition: to bring things of the same kind together over time
senses.definitionCN: 长期把同类东西聚到一起
senses.example: She collects old maps of the city.
senses.exampleCN: 她收集这座城市的旧地图。
senses.why: The Latin base meant to gather by choosing, so collecting is a series of choices.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁词基意为挑选着聚拢，所以收集是一连串选择。

senses.title: Go and get something
senses.definition: to go to a place and take something away
senses.definitionCN: 到某处把东西取走
senses.example: I will collect the tickets at the desk.
senses.exampleCN: 我会在服务台取票。
senses.why: Gathering also means walking to the place where the thing waits.
senses.whyCN: 聚拢也意味着走到物件等待的地方。

senses.title: Gather as a crowd
senses.definition: to come together in a group, as people do
senses.definitionCN: 像人群那样聚到一处
senses.example: A crowd collected outside the hall.
senses.exampleCN: 人群在大厅外聚集起来。
senses.why: People gather the way objects do, so the verb covers both.
senses.whyCN: 人聚拢的方式和物件一样，于是动词兼指两者。

intro.en: Collect comes from Latin colligere, from com- together and legere, to pick or read.
intro.cn: collect 出自拉丁语 colligere，由 com-（一起）与 legere（挑选、阅读）组成。

items.en: Legere meant to pick up, choose or read.
items.cn: legere 意为捡起、挑选或阅读。

items.en: Colligere meant to gather things into one place.
items.cn: colligere 意为把东西聚到一处。

items.en: French collecter carried the sense toward English.
items.cn: 法语 collecter 把这一含义带向英语。

items.en: English collect covered both objects and people.
items.cn: 英语 collect 同时涵盖物件与人。

items.en: It now also means to fetch something that waits for you.
items.cn: 它如今还指去取等候你的东西。

note.en: The look-alike group holds verbs built with lect, while the meaning group shades different ways of bringing things together.
note.cn: 形近组收的是含 lect 的动词，近义组细分几种聚拢的方式。

entries.definition: to choose one thing from several
entries.definitionCN: 从多个中挑出一个

entries.definition: to choose someone by voting
entries.definitionCN: 通过投票选出某人

entries.definition: to join two things together
entries.definitionCN: 把两样东西连接起来

entries.definition: to bring people or things into one place
entries.definitionCN: 把人或物聚到一处

entries.definition: to increase in amount slowly over time
entries.definitionCN: 随时间慢慢增多

entries.definition: to bring parts or people together
entries.definitionCN: 把零件或人集合起来

normalIntro.en: These hooks work from picking things up one by one, then add fetching and crowding.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从一件件捡起东西入手，再加上去取与聚拢。

normal.en: Collect and select share the Latin verb legere, to pick.
normal.cn: collect 与 select 共享拉丁动词 legere（挑选）。

normal.en: To collect is to pick many times, so the prefix com- adds them up.
normal.cn: 收集就是反复挑选，前缀 com- 把它们加在一起。

normal.en: The same verb covers stamps and parcels, because both are taken up.
normal.cn: 同一个动词既管邮票也管包裹，因为两者都是被取走。

normal.en: A crowd collects as coins collect in a box.
normal.cn: 人群聚拢，就像硬币被收进盒子。

normal.en: Collector keeps the -or ending of a person who acts.
normal.cn: collector 保留了表示施动者的 -or 词尾。

abstract.en: Picture hands moving shells from sand into a small bucket.
abstract.cn: 想象双手把贝壳从沙里捡进小桶。

abstract.en: Picture a clerk sliding a parcel across a counter.
abstract.cn: 想象职员把包裹从柜台这边推过来。

abstract.en: Picture a crowd slowly closing around a street singer.
abstract.cn: 想象人群慢慢围住一位街头歌手。

examples.en: He collects coins from the countries he visits.
examples.cn: 他收集他去过的国家的硬币。

examples.en: Please collect your bags before leaving the train.
examples.cn: 下火车前请取走您的行李。

examples.en: Students collected in the yard after the bell.
examples.cn: 铃响之后学生们在院子里聚了起来。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 collect 记成 com 加 lect：把挑出来的东西一起收进盒子。

root: 源自拉丁语 colligere，com-（一起）加 legere（挑选、捡起），本指聚拢，后扩展到领取与人群聚集。

sensesIntro.en: From picking objects up to fetching what waits for you, and then to people coming together.
sensesIntro.cn: 从把东西捡起，到去取等候之物，再到人聚到一处。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: scattered things drawn into one container.
core.cn: 核心意象：散落的东西被收进同一个容器。

branches.en: The gathering sense is the default meaning today.
branches.cn: 聚拢义是今天默认的含义。

branches.en: Fetching is gathering one waiting thing.
branches.cn: 领取就是聚拢一件等候你的东西。

branches.en: People collecting form a crowd without any object.
branches.cn: 人聚集时不涉及任何物件，只形成人群。

branches.en: Both take something into your hands from elsewhere.
branches.cn: 两者都是把别处的东西拿到手中。

branches.en: Objects and people both move toward one point.
branches.cn: 物件与人都是朝同一个点靠拢。

intro.en: The family is built on the Latin root legere, with com- and -or and -ion forming the main branches.
intro.cn: 这个词族建在拉丁词根 legere 上，com-、-or 与 -ion 构成主要分支。

latinIntro.en: Legere, to pick or read, also stands behind select, elect and lecture.
latinIntro.cn: legere（挑选、阅读）也支撑着 select、elect 与 lecture。

items.meaning: brings things together or fetches them
items.example: She collects letters from the post box.
items.exampleCN: 她从邮筒里取信。

items.meaning: gathered together or fetched
items.example: The data were collected last spring.
items.exampleCN: 这些数据是去年春天收集的。

items.meaning: the activity of gathering things
items.example: Collecting stamps taught him patience.
items.exampleCN: 集邮教会了他耐心。

items.meaning: a person who collects things
items.example: A collector paid a high price for it.
items.exampleCN: 一位收藏家为它出了高价。

items.meaning: worth keeping in a collection
items.example: The old tickets are now collectable.
items.exampleCN: 这些旧票如今成了收藏品。

items.meaning: a group of things gathered together
items.example: His collection fills three shelves.
items.exampleCN: 他的收藏占满三层架子。

items.meaning: shared by a whole group
items.example: The decision was a collective one.
items.exampleCN: 这是集体的决定。

items.meaning: the belief that the group comes first
items.example: The village practised a mild collectivism.
items.exampleCN: 这个村庄实行一种温和的集体主义。

latinEntries.example: Latin colligere joins com- with legere.
latinEntries.exampleCN: 拉丁语 colligere 由 com- 与 legere 构成。

latinEntries.meaning: to pick up, choose or read
latinEntries.example: Legere also gives English the verb select.
latinEntries.exampleCN: legere 也为英语提供了动词 select。

definition_en: a group of similar things kept together, the act of collecting, or money gathered for a cause
core_image: 整面墙的玻璃柜里排着同一主题的藏品
scene: 博物馆的玻璃柜里摆着一排排旧怀表。The museum owns a large collection of clocks.
sceneCN: 这里 collection 指「收藏品」（第 1 个义项：成套藏品）；句意是博物馆拥有一大批钟表收藏。

senses.title: A set of similar things
senses.definition: a group of similar objects kept together, often over many years
senses.definitionCN: 多年收集并放在一起的一批同类物件
senses.example: His collection fills three shelves.
senses.exampleCN: 他的收藏占满了三层架子。
senses.why: The noun turns the act of gathering into a thing you can see.
senses.whyCN: 名词把聚拢的动作变成一件看得见的东西。

senses.title: The act of collecting
senses.definition: the work of bringing things together
senses.definitionCN: 把东西聚拢起来的行为
senses.example: The collection of data took six months.
senses.exampleCN: 数据收集花了六个月。
senses.why: English often names an action with the same noun as its result.
senses.whyCN: 英语常用同一个名词兼指动作与其结果。

senses.title: Money gathered for a cause
senses.definition: money collected from many people for a special purpose
senses.definitionCN: 为特定目的向许多人募集的钱
senses.example: The class held a collection for the shelter.
senses.exampleCN: 全班为收容所举行了一次募捐。
senses.why: Coins are gathered in a box, so the gathering itself became the fund.
senses.whyCN: 硬币被收进盒子，于是这次收集本身就成了善款。

intro.en: Collection comes from Latin collectio, a gathering, from the verb colligere.
intro.cn: collection 出自拉丁语 collectio（聚集），源头是动词 colligere。

items.en: Colligere meant to gather things into one place.
items.cn: colligere 意为把东西聚到一处。

items.en: Collectio named the act and the result of gathering.
items.cn: collectio 兼指聚拢的动作与结果。

items.en: French collection kept both senses alive.
items.cn: 法语 collection 让两种含义都保留下来。

items.en: English used it for a set of writings and for money gathered.
items.cn: 英语用它指一部文集，也指募集的钱。

items.en: Museums made the word the standard label for a kept set.
items.cn: 博物馆让这个词成为成套藏品的标准说法。

note.en: The look-alike group holds nouns ending in the same sound, while the meaning group names gathered sets, stored records and given money.
note.cn: 形近组收的是结尾同音的名词，近义组列出成套之物、存档与捐款。

entries.definition: a change that makes something right
entries.definitionCN: 使某物变正确的改动

entries.definition: a link between two things or people
entries.definitionCN: 两物或两人之间的联系

entries.definition: a group chosen from a larger set
entries.definitionCN: 从更大范围中挑出的一组

entries.definition: a varied group of things of one kind
entries.definitionCN: 同类物品的多样组合

entries.definition: a store of records and documents
entries.definitionCN: 存放记录与文件的地方

entries.definition: money given to help a cause
entries.definitionCN: 为帮助某项事业而给的钱

normalIntro.en: These hooks follow the -ion noun from a kept set to an action and then to a box of coins.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子沿着 -ion 名词，从成套藏品走到动作，再到一箱硬币。

normal.en: Collection is what you get after you collect for years.
normal.cn: collect 多年之后得到的东西，就是 collection。

normal.en: The ending -ion often turns a verb into a noun of action or result.
normal.cn: 词尾 -ion 常把动词变成表示动作或结果的名词。

normal.en: The same word can mean the act and the objects, so context decides.
normal.cn: 同一个词可指动作也可指物件，靠语境分辨。

normal.en: A collection box turns small coins into a fund.
normal.cn: 募捐箱把小硬币变成一笔善款。

normal.en: A poem collection is simply poems gathered into one book.
normal.cn: 诗集不过是被收进一本书里的诗。

abstract.en: Picture a glass case filled with pocket watches, all ticking.
abstract.cn: 想象一只玻璃柜装满怀表，全都在走。

abstract.en: Picture a notebook filling with numbers month after month.
abstract.cn: 想象一本笔记本一月月被数字填满。

abstract.en: Picture a tin box on a counter slowly filling with coins.
abstract.cn: 想象柜台上一只铁盒慢慢装满硬币。

examples.en: Her collection of postcards comes from thirty countries.
examples.cn: 她的明信片收藏来自三十个国家。

examples.en: The collection of samples must follow a strict method.
examples.cn: 样本的采集必须遵循严格的方法。

examples.en: A collection was made for the family after the fire.
examples.cn: 火灾之后为这家人发起了一次募捐。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 collection 记成 collect 加 ion：收来的东西摆在一起，就是一套收藏。

root: 源自拉丁语 collectio，由 colligere（聚拢）派生，兼指收集的动作、成套藏品与募集的款项。

sensesIntro.en: One noun holds the kept set, the work of keeping it and the money gathered for others.
sensesIntro.cn: 同一个名词兼指成套藏品、收集的工作与为他人募得的钱。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a glass case where one kind of thing is arranged in rows.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只玻璃柜里，同类物件排成行。

branches.en: The kept set is the sense museums made famous.
branches.cn: 成套藏品是博物馆让它出名的义项。

branches.en: The act sense names the work before the result exists.
branches.cn: 动作义指结果出现之前的那段工作。

branches.en: The money sense grew from coins gathered in one box.
branches.cn: 款项义从收进一只盒子的硬币生长出来。

branches.en: Result and action share one noun in English.
branches.cn: 结果与动作在英语里共用一个名词。

branches.en: Both describe a gathering, of objects or of money.
branches.cn: 两者都描述聚拢，只是聚的是物件或钱。

intro.en: The family grows with -or for people, -ible for worth and compounds such as collection box.
intro.cn: 这个词族靠 -or 表人、-ible 表值得，以及 collection box 这类复合词扩展。

latinIntro.en: Collectio and colligere are the Latin sources, built on legere, to pick.
latinIntro.cn: collectio 与 colligere 是拉丁语来源，建在 legere（挑选）之上。

items.meaning: more than one gathered set
items.example: The library holds several rare collections.
items.exampleCN: 这家图书馆藏有几套珍本。

items.meaning: a box for people to put money in
items.example: A collection box stood by the door.
items.exampleCN: 门边放着一只募捐箱。

items.meaning: a person who gathers a collection
items.example: The collector knew every item by name.
items.exampleCN: 这位收藏家能叫出每件东西的名字。

items.meaning: to bring things together
items.example: They collect old photographs.
items.exampleCN: 他们收集旧照片。

items.meaning: worth keeping as a collection
items.example: The cards became highly collectible.
items.exampleCN: 这些卡片变得极具收藏价值。

items.meaning: shared by a group
items.example: The land was collective property.
items.exampleCN: 这片土地是集体财产。

items.meaning: a system that puts the group first
items.meaningCN: 群体优先的制度或信念
items.example: The plan leaned toward collectivism.
items.exampleCN: 这项计划偏向集体主义。

items.meaning: the activity of gathering a collection
items.example: Collecting runs in their family.
items.exampleCN: 收集是他们家的传统。

latinEntries.meaning: a gathering or a gathered set
latinEntries.example: The Latin collectio came from colligere.
latinEntries.exampleCN: 拉丁语 collectio 来自 colligere。

latinEntries.example: Colligere is the source of collect.
latinEntries.exampleCN: colligere 是 collect 的来源。

definition_en: a place where students study after school, especially one that gives degrees or trains for a job
core_image: 草坪尽头那排爬满常春藤的教学楼
scene: 开学那天，新生拖着箱子走进校门。She teaches history at a small college.
sceneCN: 这里 college 指「学院」（第 1 个义项：高等教育机构）；句意是她在一所小学院教历史。

senses.title: A place of higher study
senses.definition: a place where students study after secondary school
senses.definitionCN: 学生在中学之后继续求学的机构
senses.example: She is in her first year at college.
senses.exampleCN: 她上大学一年级。
senses.why: The Latin word first meant a body of people joined by a duty.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁词最初指因共同职责而结合的一群人。

senses.title: A part of a university
senses.definition: one of the separate schools that form a university
senses.definitionCN: 组成大学的独立学院之一
senses.example: He applied to the college of engineering.
senses.exampleCN: 他申请了工程学院。
senses.why: Universities divided into smaller bodies, and each kept the old name.
senses.whyCN: 大学分成较小的团体，每个团体都保留了旧名。

senses.title: A school for a special skill
senses.definition: a school that trains people for a particular job
senses.definitionCN: 为特定职业培训人才的学校
senses.example: She trained at a college of nursing.
senses.exampleCN: 她在护理专科学校受训。
senses.why: Training also gathers teachers and learners into one body.
senses.whyCN: 职业培训也把师生聚成同一个团体。

intro.en: College comes from Latin collegium, a body of people sharing a duty.
intro.cn: college 出自拉丁语 collegium，指共担职责的一群人。

items.en: Collega meant a partner in office.
items.cn: collega 指共同任职的伙伴。

items.en: Collegium named the whole body of such partners.
items.cn: collegium 指这些伙伴组成的整体。

items.en: French collège named a community of scholars.
items.cn: 法语 collège 指学者团体。

items.en: English college first meant a society of priests or students.
items.cn: 英语 college 最初指教士或学生的团体。

items.en: It now names schools, faculties and whole institutions.
items.cn: 它如今指学校、学部乃至整个机构。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words close in spelling, while the meaning group names institutions of study.
note.cn: 形近组收的是拼写相近的词，近义组列出各类教育机构。

entries.definition: a person who works with you
entries.definitionCN: 与你共事的人

entries.definition: relating to a college or its students
entries.definitionCN: 与学院或其学生有关的

entries.definition: a small settlement in the countryside
entries.definitionCN: 乡间的小居民点

entries.definition: an institution that gives degrees in many fields
entries.definitionCN: 在多个领域授予学位的机构

entries.definition: an organisation for study or research
entries.definitionCN: 从事教学或研究的机构

entries.definition: a school for a special subject or skill
entries.definitionCN: 教授专门学科或技能的学校

normalIntro.en: These hooks run from a body of scholars to a campus, then to a faculty and a training school.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从学者团体走到校园，再到学部和职业学校。

normal.en: College and colleague share a root: one is the group, the other a member.
normal.cn: college 与 colleague 同根：一个是团体，一个是成员。

normal.en: The Latin collegium was a body of partners, not a building.
normal.cn: 拉丁语 collegium 指的是一群伙伴，而不是一栋楼。

normal.en: Go to college is a phrase without an article, unlike go to the college.
normal.cn: go to college 不加冠词，表示上大学这件事本身。

normal.en: A university can hold several colleges inside it.
normal.cn: 一所大学内部可以包含好几个学院。

normal.en: The adjective collegiate keeps the same idea of a shared body.
normal.cn: 形容词 collegiate 保留的仍是共同团体的意思。

abstract.en: Picture a stone gate with ivy and a path across a lawn.
abstract.cn: 想象一座爬满常春藤的石门，一条小路穿过草坪。

abstract.en: Picture a lecture hall filling with students at nine.
abstract.cn: 想象九点时讲堂里陆续坐满学生。

abstract.en: Picture a row of practised hands learning to hold a needle.
abstract.cn: 想象一排练习拿针的手，正在学习护理。

examples.en: He plans to go to college next year.
examples.cn: 他打算明年上大学。

examples.en: The college of law is across the square.
examples.cn: 法学院在广场对面。

examples.en: She studied design at a college of art.
examples.cn: 她在艺术学院学习设计。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 college 记成一群同事共用的院子：collega 是人，collegium 是院。

root: 源自拉丁语 collegium（共担职责的团体），由 collega（同僚）集合而成，后指学者团体与求学之所。

sensesIntro.en: A body of people first, then the place where they study, and finally the parts of a university.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是一群人，再是他们求学的场所，最后是大学的各个学院。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a stone gate opening onto a lawn and a hall of study.
core.cn: 核心意象：一扇石门通向草坪与讲堂。

branches.en: The general school sense is the everyday one.
branches.cn: 泛指学校的义项是最日常的用法。

branches.en: Inside a university the word names one faculty.
branches.cn: 在大学内部，这个词指一个学部。

branches.en: A training college teaches a trade rather than a degree subject.
branches.cn: 专科学校教的是手艺，而非学位课程。

branches.en: Both senses point to an organised body of teachers and learners.
branches.cn: 两个义项都指向有组织的师生团体。

branches.en: Study and training both happen inside the same old name.
branches.cn: 求学与职业训练都发生在同一个古老名字之下。

intro.en: The family keeps the Latin collegium and grows with -iate, -ial and -ian.
intro.cn: 这个词族保留拉丁语 collegium，靠 -iate、-ial 与 -ian 扩展。

latinIntro.en: Collegium, a body of colleagues, and collega, a partner, are the Latin sources.
latinIntro.cn: collegium（同僚团体）与 collega（伙伴）是拉丁语来源。

items.meaning: more than one college
items.example: Several colleges share one library.
items.exampleCN: 几所学院共用一座图书馆。

items.meaning: relating to a college
items.example: They met in a collegiate hall.
items.exampleCN: 他们在一座学院礼堂见面。

items.meaning: friendly among equals
items.example: The staff kept a collegial spirit.
items.exampleCN: 教职员保持着同僚精神。

items.meaning: a member of a college
items.example: Every collegian wore the same tie.
items.exampleCN: 每位学院成员都戴同样的领带。

items.meaning: a person who works with you
items.example: A colleague from the college called.
items.exampleCN: 学院的一位同事打来电话。

items.meaning: a body of people sharing a duty
items.example: The Latin collegium met as one body.
items.exampleCN: 拉丁语 collegium 作为一个整体集会。

items.meaning: planning to go to college
items.example: The program helps college-bound students.
items.exampleCN: 这个项目帮助准备上大学的学生。

items.meaning: a local college with shorter courses
items.example: He took evening classes at a community college.
items.exampleCN: 他在社区学院上夜课。

latinEntries.meaning: a body of colleagues or officials
latinEntries.meaningCN: 同僚或官员组成的团体
latinEntries.example: Collegium is the direct source of college.
latinEntries.exampleCN: collegium 是 college 的直接来源。

latinEntries.example: Collega gave English the word colleague.
latinEntries.exampleCN: collega 为英语提供了 colleague。

definition_en: the quality that makes things look red, blue or green, to put colour on something, or the natural tone of a person's skin
core_image: 一整排颜料管挤出的鲜艳色带
scene: 孩子把调色盘上的每一种颜料都试了一遍。She chose a warm yellow colour for the curtains.
sceneCN: 这里 colour 指「颜色」（第 1 个义项：视觉上的色彩）；句意是她为窗帘选了一种温暖的黄色。

senses.title: The quality of light
senses.definition: the quality that makes something look red, blue, green and so on
senses.definitionCN: 使物体看起来呈红、蓝、绿等的性质
senses.example: The sky changed colour at sunset.
senses.exampleCN: 日落时天空变了颜色。
senses.why: The Latin word first meant a covering, then the surface look of things.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁词最初指覆盖物，后指物体表面的样子。

senses.title: To add colour
senses.definition: to put colour on something or change its colour
senses.definitionCN: 给某物上色或改变它的颜色
senses.example: The children coloured the map with pencils.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子们用彩笔给地图上色。
senses.why: The noun became a verb: to give a surface its colour.
senses.whyCN: 名词变成动词：给表面以颜色。

senses.title: Skin tone
senses.definition: the natural tone of a person's skin
senses.definitionCN: 人皮肤天生的色调
senses.example: People of every colour joined the march.
senses.exampleCN: 各种肤色的人都参加了游行。
senses.why: Skin is the surface we see, so its tone is simply our colour.
senses.whyCN: 皮肤是我们看见的表面，它的色调自然就是我们的颜色。

intro.en: Colour comes through Old French from Latin color, a covering or an outward look.
intro.cn: colour 经古法语上溯拉丁语 color，指覆盖物或外表。

items.en: Color meant the surface look of a thing.
items.cn: color 指物体的表面样子。

items.en: The verb colare meant to cover or hide.
items.cn: 动词 colare 意为覆盖或遮蔽。

items.en: Old French colour kept both the noun and the verb.
items.cn: 古法语 colour 同时保留名词与动词。

items.en: English colour named hue and also outward appearance.
items.cn: 英语 colour 既指色调也指外观。

items.en: American spelling dropped the u, giving color.
items.cn: 美式拼写去掉 u，写作 color。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words that sound close to colour, while the meaning group names shades and tints.
note.cn: 形近组收的是读音接近 colour 的词，近义组列出各种色调。

entries.definition: the part of a shirt that goes around the neck
entries.definitionCN: 衬衫围住脖子的部分

entries.definition: a high rank in the army
entries.definitionCN: 军队中的高级军衔

entries.definition: a person who makes a telephone call or visits
entries.definitionCN: 打电话或来访的人

entries.definition: a particular shade of colour
entries.definitionCN: 某一种特定的色调

entries.definition: a slightly different form of a colour
entries.definitionCN: 同一种颜色的细微变体

entries.definition: a pale or slight colour
entries.definitionCN: 淡淡的、浅浅的色彩

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a layer laid over a surface, then move to paint and to skin.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从覆盖在表面上的一层出发，再走到颜料与皮肤。

normal.en: The Latin base meant a covering, so colour is what covers a surface.
normal.cn: 拉丁词基意为覆盖，所以颜色就是盖在表面上的东西。

normal.en: British spelling keeps the u that American English drops.
normal.cn: 英式拼写保留了美式去掉的那个 u。

normal.en: The verb is simply the noun put to work.
normal.cn: 动词不过是名词被派去干活。

normal.en: Colourful adds -ful, meaning full of colour.
normal.cn: colourful 加 -ful，意为充满颜色。

normal.en: Skin colour is the same word because skin is the surface we see.
normal.cn: 肤色用同一个词，因为皮肤就是我们看见的表面。

abstract.en: Picture a row of paint tubes squeezed onto a glass palette.
abstract.cn: 想象一排颜料管挤在玻璃调色盘上。

abstract.en: Picture a child filling a grey drawing with red and blue.
abstract.cn: 想象孩子用红色和蓝色填满一幅灰线画。

abstract.en: Picture a sunset turning the whole river orange.
abstract.cn: 想象日落把整条河染成橘色。

examples.en: Blue is her favourite colour.
examples.cn: 蓝色是她最喜欢的颜色。

examples.en: He coloured the sky in his picture dark grey.
examples.cn: 他把画里的天空涂成了深灰色。

examples.en: The leaves change colour in late autumn.
examples.cn: 深秋时树叶会变色。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 colour 记成盖在表面的一层色：涂上去是颜色，留在皮肤上是肤色。

root: 源自拉丁语 color（外表、颜色），与 colare（覆盖）相关，经古法语进入英语，美式拼作 color。

sensesIntro.en: A surface quality first, then the act of adding it, and finally the colour of skin.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是表面的性质，再是添加它的动作，最后是皮肤的颜色。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a bright band of paint laid across a pale surface.
core.cn: 核心意象：一道鲜亮的颜料铺在浅色表面上。

branches.en: The hue sense is the everyday meaning of the noun.
branches.cn: 色调义是名词最日常的含义。

branches.en: The verb names the act of laying colour on.
branches.cn: 动词义指把颜色铺上去的动作。

branches.en: Skin tone is the same quality seen on a person.
branches.cn: 肤色就是同一种性质在人身上的呈现。

branches.en: The noun and the verb share one shape, so one image serves both.
branches.cn: 名词与动词同形，一幅画面就够用。

branches.en: A colour can describe a wall or a face.
branches.cn: 颜色既能形容墙面，也能形容面孔。

intro.en: The family grows with -ful, -less, -ing and the prefix dis- to make discoloured.
intro.cn: 这个词族靠 -ful、-less、-ing 与前缀 dis- 构成 discoloured。

latinIntro.en: Color and colare are the Latin sources; the base still means an outward covering.
latinIntro.cn: color 与 colare 是拉丁语来源，词基仍指外在的覆盖。

items.meaning: more than one colour, or he adds colour
items.example: The room uses three warm colours.
items.exampleCN: 这个房间用了三种暖色。

items.meaning: given colour, or having colour
items.example: She wore a brightly coloured scarf.
items.exampleCN: 她戴了一条颜色鲜艳的围巾。

items.meaning: the act of adding colour or a substance that colours
items.example: The sweet contains no artificial colouring.
items.exampleCN: 这种糖果不含人工色素。

items.meaning: full of bright colours or lively detail
items.meaningCN: 色彩丰富的；生动多彩的
items.example: The market was noisy and colourful.
items.exampleCN: 市场喧闹而色彩缤纷。

items.meaning: having no colour or no interest
items.example: The gas is colourless and odourless.
items.exampleCN: 这种气体无色无味。

items.meaning: changed in colour, often for the worse
items.meaningCN: 变色了，通常指变得难看
items.example: The old paper had discoloured at the edges.
items.exampleCN: 旧纸的边缘已经变色。

items.meaning: having many colours
items.example: A multicoloured flag hung above the door.
items.exampleCN: 门上方挂着一面彩色旗。

items.meaning: unable to tell certain colours apart
items.example: He is colour-blind to red and green.
items.exampleCN: 他分不清红色和绿色。

latinEntries.example: Latin color is the direct source of colour.
latinEntries.exampleCN: 拉丁语 color 是 colour 的直接来源。

latinEntries.example: Colare links colour to the idea of covering.
latinEntries.exampleCN: colare 把 colour 与覆盖的想法连起来。

definition_en: a tall stone post that holds up a building, a regular article in a newspaper, or a line of people or things one behind another
core_image: 一根笔直撑起屋顶的高石柱
scene: 古老的剧院门前立着一排高大的石柱。A white column still stands at the temple gate.
sceneCN: 这里 column 指「柱」（第 1 个义项：支撑建筑的石柱）；句意是神庙门口仍立着一根白色石柱。

senses.title: A supporting post
senses.definition: a tall stone or wooden post that holds up part of a building
senses.definitionCN: 支撑建筑某部分的高石柱或木柱
senses.example: The roof rests on six columns.
senses.exampleCN: 屋顶由六根柱子支撑。
senses.why: The Latin word meant the top of a pillar, the part that carries the weight.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁词指柱子的顶端，即承重的部分。

senses.title: A regular newspaper piece
senses.definition: a regular article on one subject in a newspaper or magazine
senses.definitionCN: 报刊上关于某一主题的定期文章
senses.example: She writes a weekly column on food.
senses.exampleCN: 她写每周一篇的美食专栏。
senses.why: Print set text in narrow vertical strips, and the page gave the article its name.
senses.whyCN: 印刷把文字排成窄长的竖条，版面便给了这篇文章名字。

senses.title: A line of people or things
senses.definition: a line of people or things standing or arranged one behind another
senses.definitionCN: 人或物前后排成的一列
senses.example: A column of smoke rose from the hill.
senses.exampleCN: 山上升起一柱烟。
senses.why: A pillar is tall and narrow, so anything in a narrow line takes the shape.
senses.whyCN: 柱子又高又窄，于是任何窄长的一列都沿用这个形状。

intro.en: Column comes from Latin columna, a pillar, from columen, the top or summit.
intro.cn: column 出自拉丁语 columna（柱），更早是 columen（顶端、屋脊）。

items.en: Columen meant the top or ridge of a roof.
items.cn: columen 指屋顶的顶端或屋脊。

items.en: Columna named the pillar that held the roof up.
items.cn: columna 指撑起屋顶的柱子。

items.en: French colomne carried the word toward English.
items.cn: 法语 colomne 把词带向英语。

items.en: Printers used column for a vertical strip of text.
items.cn: 印刷者用 column 指竖排的一条文字。

items.en: The word also names a line of troops or of smoke.
items.cn: 这个词也指一列队伍或一道烟。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words close in spelling, while the meaning group names upright posts and lines.
note.cn: 形近组收的是拼写相近的词，近义组列出直立的柱与成行之物。

entries.definition: a territory ruled by another country
entries.definitionCN: 由他国统治的地区

entries.definition: serious and formal in manner
entries.definitionCN: 神态严肃庄重的

entries.definition: a book, or the amount of space something fills
entries.definitionCN: 书卷；或某物占的空间量

entries.definition: a tall upright post of stone or wood
entries.definitionCN: 高大的石制或木制立柱

entries.definition: a strong upright piece of wood or metal
entries.definitionCN: 坚固的竖直木柱或金属柱

entries.definition: a line of things placed side by side
entries.definitionCN: 并排摆放的一行

normalIntro.en: These hooks stand on the picture of a pillar, then lie down as a strip of print and a line of smoke.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子立在柱子的画面上，再横躺成一条文字与一道烟。

normal.en: Column and colony start alike but grow in different directions.
normal.cn: column 与 colony 开头相似，含义却走向不同方向。

normal.en: The silent n in column comes from the Latin columna.
normal.cn: column 里不发音的 n 来自拉丁语 columna。

normal.en: A pillar holds up a roof, and a printed column holds up a page.
normal.cn: 石柱撑住屋顶，印刷的栏撑住版面。

normal.en: The same tall narrow shape becomes a line of soldiers.
normal.cn: 同一个高而窄的形状变成了行军的队伍。

normal.en: A columnist is the person who fills the column.
normal.cn: columnist 就是填满这个专栏的人。

abstract.en: Picture a temple front of white pillars against blue sky.
abstract.cn: 想象蓝天下一排白色神庙立柱。

abstract.en: Picture one narrow strip of news down a wide page.
abstract.cn: 想象宽大版面上一条窄窄的新闻栏。

abstract.en: Picture a thin line of smoke rising without a bend.
abstract.cn: 想象一道细烟笔直升起。

examples.en: The hall is held up by twelve stone columns.
examples.cn: 大厅由十二根石柱支撑。

examples.en: His column appears in the paper every Friday.
examples.cn: 他的专栏每周五见报。

examples.en: A column of trucks waited at the border.
examples.cn: 一列卡车在边境等候。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 column 记成又高又窄的一条：立起来是石柱，排下去是一列。

root: 源自拉丁语 columna（柱），更早是 columen（顶端、屋脊），后引申为竖排文字、专栏与成列之物。

sensesIntro.en: A tall support first, then a vertical strip of print, and then any narrow line.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是高耸的支撑，再是竖排的一条文字，最后是任何窄长的一列。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a straight tall shape rising from the ground.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个笔直高耸、从地面升起的形状。

branches.en: The stone post is the oldest and most physical sense.
branches.cn: 石柱义最古老，也最具体。

branches.en: Printing turned the tall shape into a strip of text.
branches.cn: 印刷把这个高长形状变成一条文字。

branches.en: Any narrow line borrows the same vertical image.
branches.cn: 任何窄长的一列都借用同一个竖直意象。

branches.en: A pillar and a line of trucks share one narrow shape.
branches.cn: 石柱与车队共享同一个窄长形状。

branches.en: A printed column is itself a line of words.
branches.cn: 印刷的栏本身就是一行行文字排成的列。

intro.en: The family adds -ist for the writer, -ar and -ed for shape, and compounds from daily print.
intro.cn: 这个词族用 -ist 表写作者，用 -ar 与 -ed 表形状，并有日常印刷中的复合词。

latinIntro.en: Columna and columen are the Latin sources, with no prefix needed for the base.
latinIntro.cn: columna 与 columen 是拉丁语来源，词基本身不需前缀。

items.meaning: more than one pillar, column or line
items.meaningCN: 多根柱子、多个专栏或多列
items.example: The table has four columns of numbers.
items.exampleCN: 表格有四列数字。

items.meaning: a writer of a regular newspaper column
items.example: The columnist answered readers every week.
items.exampleCN: 这位专栏作家每周回答读者提问。

items.meaning: shaped like a column
items.example: The rock has a columnar structure.
items.exampleCN: 这块岩石呈柱状结构。

items.meaning: having columns
items.example: They entered a columned hall.
items.exampleCN: 他们走进一座有柱的大厅。

items.meaning: a unit measuring printed space
items.example: The advert took two column inches.
items.exampleCN: 这则广告占了两栏英寸。

items.meaning: a newspaper piece about private lives
items.meaningCN: 报道私人生活的报纸栏目
items.example: The gossip column named no one.
items.exampleCN: 这个八卦专栏没有点名。

items.meaning: the line of bones in the back
items.meaningCN: 背部由骨节连成的一列
items.example: The spinal column protects the nerves.
items.exampleCN: 脊柱保护着神经。

items.meaning: the post that holds a car's wheel
items.example: He adjusted the steering column.
items.exampleCN: 他调整了转向柱。

latinEntries.example: Columna is the direct source of column.
latinEntries.exampleCN: columna 是 column 的直接来源。

latinEntries.example: Columen is the older form behind columna.
latinEntries.exampleCN: columen 是 columna 背后更古老的形式。

definition_zh: 结合；组合；组合体；密码组合
definition_en: the act of joining two or more things together, or the set of things that results from being joined
core_image: 几块不同的拼图严丝合缝地扣在一起，成了一张完整的画
scene: 厨房里，厨师把几种香料依次撒进锅里。The combination of spices gave the soup a deep flavour.
sceneCN: 这里 combination 指「结合；组合」（第 1 个义项：把事物合在一起）；句意是几种香料的搭配让汤有了浓郁的味道。

senses.title: The act of joining
senses.definition: the act of putting two or more things together
senses.definitionCN: 把两样或更多事物放在一起的动作
senses.example: The combination of heat and water slowly softens the beans.
senses.exampleCN: 热与水的共同作用慢慢把豆子煮软。
senses.why: Two things act as one, so the joining itself becomes a thing you can name.
senses.whyCN: 两样东西合为一体，这个「合」的过程本身就成了一件可以命名的事。

senses.title: A set of joined things
senses.definition: a set of different things that are used or seen together
senses.definitionCN: 搭配在一起使用或出现的一组不同事物
senses.example: The room was decorated in a combination of blue and grey.
senses.exampleCN: 房间用蓝灰两色搭配装饰。
senses.why: Once joined, the parts are seen as one whole set rather than separate items.
senses.whyCN: 一旦结合，各部分就被看成一个整体，而不再是一件件单独的东西。

senses.title: Numbers that open a lock
senses.definition: the particular order of numbers or letters needed to open a lock
senses.definitionCN: 打开锁所需要的特定数字或字母顺序
senses.example: He forgot the combination to his bicycle lock.
senses.exampleCN: 他忘了自行车锁的密码。
senses.why: A lock opens only when its numbers are joined in exactly one order.
senses.whyCN: 锁只有在数字按唯一顺序组合起来时才会打开。

intro.en: Combination comes from Latin combinare, which meant to join two things, two by two.
intro.cn: combination 来自拉丁语 combinare，本义是把两样东西成对地并在一起。

items.en: Combinare joined com-, meaning together, with bini, meaning two each.
items.cn: combinare 把表示「一起」的 com- 与意为「各两个」的 bini 合在一起。

items.en: Combinatio named the act of joining things.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁语 combinatio 指把事物结合起来的动作。

items.en: Old French combinacion carried the word into daily speech.
items.cn: 古法语 combinacion 把这个词带进了日常语言。

items.en: English combination first meant a union of two parties.
items.cn: 英语 combination 最初指两方的联合。

items.en: It spread to spices, colours, teams and the codes of locks.
items.cn: 后来它扩展到香料、颜色、团队以及锁的密码。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words that share the shape of combination, while the meaning group names other ways of joining or mixing.
note.cn: 形近组收的是与 combination 形似的词，近义组列出其他表示结合与混合的词。

entries.definition: to join two things so that they work together
entries.definitionCN: 把两样东西结合起来

entries.definition: the act of finishing something
entries.definitionCN: 完成；结束

entries.definition: the process of burning
entries.definitionCN: 燃烧的过程

entries.definition: a combination of different substances
entries.definitionCN: 不同物质的混合物

entries.definition: a smooth combination of things
entries.definitionCN: 融合；混合

entries.definition: the joining of two or more groups
entries.definitionCN: 联合；结合

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from the act of joining, then move to the set that results and to the code on a lock.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从结合的动作出发，再走到由此形成的组合与锁上的密码。

normal.en: Com- means together and bini means two each, so the word is built on pairing.
normal.cn: com- 表示一起，bini 表示各两个，这个词天生就在讲配对。

normal.en: A combination lock opens only when its numbers line up in one order.
normal.cn: 密码锁只有在数字按唯一顺序对齐时才会打开。

normal.en: Spices, colours and players all grow stronger as a combination.
normal.cn: 香料、颜色和球员，一旦组合起来都更有力量。

normal.en: Think of a recipe: no single spice, but a combination, gives the taste.
normal.cn: 想想菜谱：让味道成型的不是某一种香料，而是它们的组合。

normal.en: The verb is combine and the noun is combination, one act and one result.
normal.cn: 动词是 combine，名词是 combination，一个是动作，一个是结果。

abstract.en: Picture four puzzle pieces clicking into one picture.
abstract.cn: 想象四块拼图扣在一起，成为一幅画。

abstract.en: Picture a chef tasting the soup and adding one more spice.
abstract.cn: 想象厨师尝一口汤，又添了一味香料。

abstract.en: Picture fingers turning a dial until the lock clicks open.
abstract.cn: 想象手指转动密码盘，直到锁咔哒一声打开。

examples.en: The combination of rain and sun made the garden grow fast.
examples.cn: 雨水与阳光的结合让花园长得很快。

examples.en: Her recipe is a combination of three family dishes.
examples.cn: 她的做法是三道家常菜的融合。

examples.en: Nobody could guess the combination of the safe.
examples.cn: 没人猜得出保险柜的密码。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 combination 记成 com（一起）加 bination：两样东西一起放下，就成了一个组合。

root: 由拉丁语 combinare 而来，com- 表示一起，bini 表示各两个，本义是把两样东西并在一起，后引申为组合体与锁的密码。

sensesIntro.en: From the act of joining, to the set that results, and finally to the code that opens a lock.
sensesIntro.cn: 从结合的动作，到由此形成的组合，再到开锁的密码。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: several pieces fitted so tightly that they work as one.
core.cn: 核心意象：几块不同的拼图严丝合缝地扣在一起，成了一张完整的画。

branches.en: The joining act is the oldest and plainest sense.
branches.cn: 结合的动作是最古老也最朴素的义项。

branches.en: The result of joining is seen as one whole set.
branches.cn: 结合的结果被看成一个整体的组合。

branches.en: A lock code is a combination in the most literal order.
branches.cn: 锁的密码是把数字按最严格的顺序所做的组合。

branches.en: Act and result are two sides of the same joining.
branches.cn: 动作与结果是同一次结合的两面。

branches.en: Spices and numbers both work only in the right combination.
branches.cn: 香料和数字都只有在正确的组合下才起作用。

intro.en: Combination is built from the verb combine plus the noun ending -ation.
intro.cn: combination 由动词 combine 加名词后缀 -ation 构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin base combinare already carried the idea of pairing two things.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词基 combinare 早已含有把两样东西配对的意思。

items.meaning: more than one combination
items.example: The safe has thousands of possible combinations.
items.exampleCN: 这个保险箱有成千上万种可能的密码组合。

items.meaning: relating to a combination
items.example: The chip uses combinational logic.
items.exampleCN: 这种芯片使用组合逻辑。

items.meaning: to join things together
items.example: Combine the two lists into one.
items.exampleCN: 把两个名单合成一个。

items.meaning: joins things together
items.example: She combines work with study.
items.exampleCN: 她把工作与学习结合起来。

items.meaning: joined into one whole
items.example: The combined teams won easily.
items.exampleCN: 联合起来的队伍轻松获胜。

items.meaning: the act of joining things
items.example: Combining colours well takes practice.
items.exampleCN: 把颜色搭配好需要练习。

items.meaning: able to be combined
items.example: These two plans are combinable.
items.exampleCN: 这两个方案可以合并。

items.meaning: a new combination of existing parts
items.example: Gene recombination changes the result.
items.exampleCN: 基因重组改变了结果。

items.meaning: the mathematics of counting arrangements
items.example: He studies combinatorics at university.
items.exampleCN: 他在大学研究组合数学。
